title: IC Trainer: an interactive app to learn EEG independent component classification
description:
IC Trainer is an interactive web app that trains people to classify EEG independent components (neural, blink, eye movement, muscle, bad channel, rare event, mixed/other) before removing artifacts, following the practical guide by Chaumon, Bishop & Busch (2015). It combines a learning section, single-component practice with feedback, and full-dataset review scored with signal detection measures (hit rate, false alarms, d′) against SASICA-style automated measures. All components are simulated for teaching. Open the app.

Developed during the personal projects session (hackathon) of the Training School of Working Group 3 of the INDoS COST Action (CA24161), Madrid, 30 September to 2 October 2026.
